description: Committed and spot rates for one GPU (or every GPU) set against the same provider's own on-demand rate for the same card, region and price scope - the pairs behind the site's typical discount - with the median per term across every card. A commitment is paid whether the GPU runs or not.

gpu.description: Optional GPU id or name; without it, every card.

limit.description: Pairs to return, largest saving first; default 15.

term.description: Which market to pair; default any (1-year, 3-year and spot).
